mapper.update: UPDATE wms_outbound_order SET sync_status = '同步中', last_sync_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = '已完成' AND deleted_at = 0 AND ( sync_status IN ('待同步', '同步失败') OR (sync_status = '同步中' AND (last_sync_time IS NULL OR last_sync_time < #{staleBefore})) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wms_outbound_order WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND status = '已完成' AND ( sync_status IN ('待同步', '同步失败') OR (sync_status = '同步中' AND (last_sync_time IS NULL OR last_sync_time < #{staleBefore})) ) ORDER BY last_sync_time IS NULL DESC, last_sync_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM wms_outbound_order WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND status = '已分配' AND update_time < #{before} ORDER BY update_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_outbound_order SET sync_status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_sync_error = #{error}, last_sync_time = NOW(), sync_fail_count = IF(#{status} = '同步成功', 0, sync_fail_count + 1), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0
